title: Stage 5 congestion and pacing profile safety seam
purpose: Prepare a separate protocol-sensitive congestion and pacing architecture that can force only the retained NewReno and existing private CUBIC controllers without weakening network safety or enabling active selection.
scope: This checkpoint defines connection-start forcing, observe-only and research-only shadow identity, unified evidence, deterministic rollback, safety review, and a later campaign contract. It does not claim CUBIC is conservative, safe for production, or faster, and it does not authorize measurement or activation.
context: NewReno remains the default controller. CUBIC is already implemented and tested as a private construction-time controller. Path migration resets per-path recovery state while retaining the immutable controller selected for the connection.

requirements.title: Force a connection-lifetime congestion and pacing profile without weakening network safety
requirements.statement: The runtime MUST expose the congestion_pacing_profile axis with the closed legacy_current and cubic values; map legacy_current to the retained NewReno controller and cubic only to the already-implemented private CUBIC controller; support disabled, observe-only, research-only shadow, forced-legacy, and forced-cubic operation with forced, recommended, selected, and applied identities distinct; select exactly once at connection construction and retain the selected controller for the connection lifetime while path migration or recovery reset reinitializes the same controller without reselection; make congestion-window, bytes-in-flight, pacing, recovery, loss, PTO, ECN, anti-amplification, flow-control, packet, ownership, lifecycle, cancellation, disposal, close, and shutdown guards authoritative under every force value; override forced CUBIC to NewReno for missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, invalid, out-of-domain, or lifecycle input with bounded reasons; publish the immutable decision and exact observation, snapshot, rule, reason, and provenance versions in every unified epoch; reject mismatched configuration and simultaneous behavior-distinct forcing; independently prove force-legacy rollback and diagnostic-sink neutrality; exclude scenario, workload, payload constants, requested concurrency, peer, URL, host, and application identity from controller inputs; keep shadow recommendation at legacy_current until a later reviewed rule exists; and keep performance measurement, active_internal, and production activation unavailable.
notes: CUBIC is a research candidate, not a separately accepted conservative profile.
Shadow recommends legacy_current only; no candidate-selection rule or production threshold exists.
